description: This Java interface `QueryCommandAdapter` is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and acts as a mixin for query command adapters, defining default behaviors related to topic criteria, actions, and response handling.

classes.name: QueryCommandAdapter
classes.description: An interface providing default implementations for query command behavior within the Ditto protocol adapter, parameterized by command type.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of topic criteria, defaulting to COMMANDS.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of topic actions, defaulting to RETRIEVE.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether the adapter is for responses, defaulting to false.
